title: Member search finds public Journeys, published Spotlights and Market products

source.ref: Search coverage scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Make search cover every public item)

detail:
Owner ask 2026-11-17: member search should touch every forward-facing item. The /search page and the live search (app/api/search/route.ts, components/search/search-overlay.tsx) read people, posts, events, circles, Spaces and practices only. Production 2026-11-17 holds 6 public library Journeys, 4 published member Spotlights and 35 active Market products (commerce_products market_published) that no search can reach: typing a Journey's or a product's exact title returns nothing. Daniel ruled on 2026-11-17 (decision card in the thread) that public Journeys DO appear in member search while /journeys stays hidden from the menu. Fix: three gated readers in search-data.ts (journey_plans public and not rejected; profiles active, not system, meta.spotlight.published, linking /spotlight/<handle>; listMarketListings' gates while the makers area is browsable), wired into both surfaces as tabs and categories.

DONE 2026-11-17: the /search page and the live search read public Journeys, published Spotlights and Market products (while the makers area is browsable) as their own tabs and categories.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
